title: Semaglutide and cardiovascular risk in type 1 diabetes: A predictive modelling analysis in a double‐blind, randomised, placebo‐controlled cross‐over trial
comparison_or_design: The semaglutide cardiovascular-risk secondary analysis over the completed treatment periods.
time_scope: Baseline to the end of each 15-week treatment period.
excluded: The sensitivity analysis excluding transient microalbuminuria and actual CVD events
All other risk-model input variables and parent-trial glycemic outcomes
population_or_material: The cardiovascular-risk secondary-analysis cohort completing both treatment periods without established CVD.
requested_items: Baseline pooled median 10-year risk; reported period-specific risk percentage changes and paired placebo-adjusted contrasts; reported paired weight/HbA1c contrasts.
